## Survey open-0: LIN-4467 @ dc12ca51b

Piece 2 (#2441) is the base, so `blind-read-words.js` and the AST scan exist.

**Why it will be hard**

1. **"Import-free" and "signals" pull against each other.** `lib/completion-signals.js` imports `workflow-config`, `as-asked` and `size-of-move` (the last two import `description-edit.js`), and its signal text interpolates those words. A leaf holding signal text stops being import-free; otherwise it holds only a pointer. The file is also **Runs**-area in `docs/areas/areas.json`, and `audit.js` reads it, so moving its rows moves who owns them. Decide this first and say it on LIN-4448.

2. **Some "views" are only partial.** `STAGE_LABELS` carries six kinds with no template (`leftover`, `autopilot`, `wake`, `periodical`, `custom`, `defer`). `JOBS` carries 18 non-template ids and is "pure data, on purpose": deriving it makes `llm-jobs-census.test.js` vacuous, so expect it to stay. `STEP_KIND_WORDS` (`lib/run-view.js:96`) repeats eight labels but is **not** in `stage-kind-tables.test.js`, so enumerating from the test alone misses it.

3. **`VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` has one reader**: `.LOOK_INTO`, in the defs file (line 306). Deleting it is cheaper than making it a view.

4. **`STAGE_INTENT` doesn't follow from `writes` alone.** READING matches `none`/`one-comment`, and `blind-comment` gets BLIND. But triage has its own line, the work kinds split DECIDE and JUDGE, and several kinds add extra lines. Only the reading-pass lines can be derived.

5. **The byte freeze is easy to dodge without meaning to.** `route.when`/`whenNot`, descriptions and leads are prompt text. Moving them out of `prompt-template-defs.js` lowers its source ceiling, and the new leaf is outside `TEMPLATES_SOURCE_CEILINGS`. Budget the leaf in the same PR (Lessons 1 and 6).

6. **The AST scan's allowlist is `TABLES`.** Deleting a table also deletes its row-key allowance. Key the record with `[BLIND_READ_KIND]:`.

7. **`llms.txt` is a static file in `public/`.** Its bullets are separate short wording under category headings, not the template `description`. Generating them means a new `catalogue` field or drift in a public doc, plus a choice between a checked-in block with a freshness test and serving it dynamically.

8. **`generate()` can't move into a leaf.** The defs file imports `run-ledger` and `run-trail`. `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` becomes record + generate, not a pure view.

**What I'd do first**

Commit the witness before moving anything. Piece 2's byte-identity render was never checked in. Snapshot at dc12ca51b:
- every kind through `generatePrompt`, fresh and fix round, with real context;
- `JSON.stringify` of `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, `STAGE_INTENT` and `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`;
- `stageLabel()` for every kind;
- the override line from `buildInstructions`;
- the router's route list.

Then settle the stay/go calls (1–4) before writing the record. The Waiting rewrite will name `SPINE`, `BUCKET_OF_KIND`, `FIRST_PASS_KINDS`, `OFF_SPINE_KINDS`, `JOBS`, the ceilings, the contract and probably the signal text: well over four.

**Collisions:** #2441 touched `run-view`, `completion-signals` and `llm-jobs`. Rebase over LIN-4447 and #2427 first.

## Survey global: LIN-4467 @ dc12ca51b

**Where it lands.** `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (1,373 lines, size-frozen, changed in most merges), plus the 16 tables listed in `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js`, spread across 13 files. The area is improving: piece 2, LIN-4455, LIN-4458 and LIN-4465 each moved shared words into one owner. But the guard test has become a list in its own right (kinds left out, each with a reason), and one kind is now described in five places: `description`, `STAGE_LEADS`, `route.when`, its `JOBS` row and its `llms.txt` bullet. Separately, the `run-view.js` entry in `source-map.md` still shows the spine without the blind read.

**Done the obvious way:**
- **"Import-free" won't hold.** The `COMPLETION_SIGNALS` text uses `as-asked.js` and `size-of-move.js`, which are leaves but contain parsers. `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`'s values are functions in `prompt-formatters.js`. So the record either imports those leaves, or the signal text stays where it is, keyed by kind. The real constraint is the cycle (lesson LIN-4376). State the rule as "imports leaves only", and test it.
- **Turning the `route`/`writes` pins into a view defeats them.** `PINNED` calls itself "the one non-circular check". Read from the record, it would check the record against itself. Keep it hand-typed, as a witness.
- **`JOBS` stays.** It is pure data on purpose, so its census isn't vacuous, and 19 of its 39 rows aren't template kinds.
- **Delete `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` rather than making it a view.** It has 16 rows and one reader (`prompt-template-defs.js:306`).
- **`STAGE_LABELS`** carries 6 kinds that aren't templates (leftover, autopilot, wake, periodical, custom, defer). They stay as a literal, merged under the same export so the goldens hold.
- **The override list** in `proxy-instructions.js` is hand-typed and misses 4 kinds. That module avoids the registry, so a leaf record is what lets it derive the list. The catalogue text changes (agent-api Waiting).
- **`llms.txt` is served static from `public/`.** Nothing in the repo generates part of a doc today, so this needs a generator plus a drift test, or a splice at serve time. Its bullets aren't the `description` text. `description` also feeds `routes/dispatch.js:641` and `/templates`, so the triage fix reaches both of those.
- **What else must learn about the record:** `TABLES` also builds the LIN-4466 scan's `KEYED_TABLES`. If the record isn't listed there, the blind read's key in it fails the scan. Also `lib/audit.js:590`, which reads `COMPLETION_SIGNALS` directly; the 20 `completionSignals:` lines (already a view); the "20 templates" line in source-map; `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES`; and a change-log row.

**Better, at a cost this task can carry.** A record that is data only: route, writes, label, grounding names, category, catalogue line. Signal text and grounding functions stay beside their imports, keyed by the record and checked by its test. Delete `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS`, derive the override list, keep `PINNED`, and fix the spine line. The Waiting entry then names what stays, each with its owner: `JOBS`, `PINNED`, the ceilings, the four Runs tables and the contract.

**Better still, not this task's.** Cutting five per-kind descriptions to two. That moves router snapshots (lesson LIN-4369), the selector and the Settings rows.

## Implementation: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2444

One record per stage kind (`lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`). The per-kind tables are views of it; `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` is deleted; `public/llms.txt`'s catalogue is generated from the records.

**Evidence**
- Renders: 40 (20 kinds, fresh and fix round, real context) and every per-kind table match HEAD byte for byte. The witness was committed at HEAD before the refactor (`tests/fixtures/lin-4467-witness.json`). Two deliberate changes: triage's description ("assignee" to "state, project") and the verb-override list (16 kinds to 20).
- Tests: 173 affected unit-test files, 6021 of 6021 pass locally; goldens and snapshots pass.
- CI on the PR: CI success, unit, unit (proxy), secret scan and all four E2E shards green.

**Needs a ruling before merge** (on LIN-4448, `DECISION:` / `BLOCKED:`): (1) "import-free" became "imports leaves only"; (2) the route/writes pins stay hand-typed; plus the budget raise of +17660 (`FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` 378915 to 396575), which moved text in from unbudgeted files.

**Retires:** the per-kind literal tables, the hand-copied `llms.txt` bullets, and the "~fourteen parallel tables" Waiting entry (rewritten to name the tables that stay and why).

### Engineering settlement for the three points the PR text lists as needing a ruling (autopilot)

These are engineering questions, not John's calls (no product, money, authority or retirement question), so they are settled here with reasons. Review remains free to disagree on the evidence.

1. **"Import-free" becomes "imports leaves only": accepted.** The record needs the signal text's helpers (`as-asked.js`, `size-of-move.js`), which are leaves with parsers. The constraint that matters is the import cycle (lesson LIN-4376), and the new rule is testable.
2. **The route and writes pins stay hand-typed: accepted.** `PINNED` is the one non-circular check; deriving it from the record would check the record against itself.
3. **`FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` 378915 to 396575 (+17660): accepted as re-accounting, on one condition.** The text moved into a newly budgeted leaf from files the total did not cover, and the PR reports byte-identical renders (40 renders and every per-kind table). John on this limit: "That limit is to push against lists of rules. Worth knowing, but not hard and fast." Condition: piece 5 (LIN-4469) must show a net rendered-byte reduction and lower the ceiling. Review should re-run the render comparison itself and confirm that nothing but the two declared changes moved (triage's description wording, and the verb-override list from 16 kinds to 20).

## Review — LIN-4467

Reviewed PR [#2444](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2444) at head `c0986ba28`. Its base is `b8e2a0aad`, which is current `origin/main`. Nothing has landed on the touched paths since the ticket was created. The PR has two commits: the witness at `684fde033`, then the refactor.

CI: green on `c0986ba28`. Passing checks: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success.

### Independent render comparison (re-run by review, not the implementer's numbers)

I wrote my own dump script (in the scratchpad, not the committed witness). It writes **full text**, not hashes, at the witness commit `684fde033` (= main + fixture) and at `c0986ba28`, and I diffed the two.
- **80 renders** through `generatePrompt`: 20 kinds × 4 contexts. Two are the witness's fresh and fix-round contexts. Two are mine: a Done issue with an empty context, and a read-only provider (`write/comments/subtasks: false`) in the fix round. **All 80 are byte-identical.**
- Tables. Each one's content, sorted, is identical: `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, `STAGE_INTENT`, `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`, `STAGE_LEADS`, `STAGE_LABELS`, `stageLabel` and `stepKindWord` for the 20 kinds, the six non-template kinds and an unknown kind, and `formatStageContract` with write on and off.
- Key order changed in `GROUNDING_BY_KIND` and `STAGE_INTENT`. The witness's `canonical()` sorts keys, so it cannot see this. It is harmless: the only readers are `Object.hasOwn` lookups (`lib/prompt-formatters.js:526,682`, `lib/prompts/stage-intent.js:18`).
- What actually moved:
  - (a) triage's `description`: "labels, priority, assignee" became "labels, priority, state, project". This matches `lib/stage-writes.js:18`.
  - (b) the VERB OVERRIDE list: 16 kinds became 20, in registry order.
  - (c) a third change: in `public/llms.txt` the catalogue moved to registry order (`plan` moves up; `retro` and `retrospective-audit` swap). No bullet's text changed. The PR body (DECISION 5) and the LIN-4448 comment declare it. The change-log row and the settlement's "two declared changes" leave it out (fix 3 below).
- The router prompt is pinned byte for byte by `tests/fixtures/stage-router-prompts/`, and those tests are green in CI.

### Requirements, sentence by sentence (`## As asked`)
- **Import-free leaf, one record per kind, kind and heading from `blind-read-words.js`.** Met: `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js` takes the blind read's key and words from the leaf. "Imports leaves only" is not a narrowing. The block itself has the record import `blind-read-words.js`, so "import-free" can only mean no non-leaf imports. The transitive-import test enforces this.
- **No `STAGE_KINDS` beside the tables; each superseded table goes.** Met. The literals are gone and `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` is deleted.
- **Views.** Met:
  - `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` is the record plus the `GENERATE` map.
  - `STAGE_LEADS`, `COMPLETION_SIGNALS` and `GROUNDING_BY_KIND` are views (grounding is by list name).
  - `STAGE_LABELS` is the record plus the six-kind literal.
  - Each template's `route` and `writes` come from the record.
  - `PINNED` stays hand-typed. The block's own witness (ii) has `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` shrink "to the tables that stay", so keeping it is what was asked, not a cut.
- **Enumerate from `stage-kind-tables.test.js`.** Met: the contract, the override list and `STEP_KIND_WORDS` are views, and `JOBS` stays with its reason. My census agrees with the PR: 39 rows, 19 of them not template kinds, so the "18" in survey open-0 was wrong. One part is unmet: **`STAGE_INTENT` "its reading-pass lines follow from `writes`"**. The six reading-pass lines are hand-typed `intent: [READING]` / `[BLIND]` beside `writes`. A test holds the relation (`lin-4253` "related, not folded"; my mutation M7 turns it red), but the lines are not derived. See ledger item 3.
- **Runs tables and byte ceilings stay.** Met.
- **Assignee.** Met, with a test (`lin-4467-stage-kind-record.test.js`).
- **`llms.txt` generated; its test checks content.** Met: `scripts/gen-llms-catalogue.mjs` plus a byte-for-byte test, and `--check` passes.
- **Witness (i).** Met, and re-run independently as described above.
- **Witness (ii).** `stage-kind-tables.test.js` shrank, and the required-field test bites (M1). `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` did **not** shrink: its "every template declares both traits" block (lines 95–112) now duplicates the record's field check (ledger item 4).
- **Witness (iii).** Met: traits, labels and goldens are unchanged (CI and witness).
- **Collisions: "say so on LIN-4447".** Not done. The PR body argues the values are identical. But the ask's reason is the after-read's *code sample*: `lib/completion-signals.js` went from about 250 lines to a short view, and that changes the sample whatever the values (ledger item 1).
- **Retires.** Met. The Waiting entry `lib/prompt-template-defs.js: ~fourteen parallel tables` is removed and rewritten under `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`. The rewrite names JOBS, PINNED, the four Runs tables, the six labels and two step words, and the ceilings, each with owner and reason. That is more than four. The PR's `Retires:` line names that entry.
- **Starting point: course changes said on LIN-4448.** Done (comment of 21:23Z).

### Engineering settlement, budget, rulings
- Rulings for LIN-4467: none open or resolved. The settlement comment (21:30Z) accepts items 1 and 2, and per the reading above neither is a cut of the block. The `BLOCKED: merge waits on the ruling on 1 and 2` line in the LIN-4448 comment therefore holds nothing. Close-out says so (fix 5).
- Budget: `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js` is budgeted at 43001 in `TEMPLATES_SOURCE_CEILINGS`, and `scripts/steady-base-check.mjs` counts it. `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` rises 378915 → 396575 (+17660), the net of five ceilings against four, with a reason on every row. Rendered bytes are unchanged (80 of 80). This is re-accounting, accepted on the settlement's condition. LIN-4469's description plans to lower the total but does not name the condition (ledger item 2).

### Regression and class check
- `git log` on every touched file: piece 1 (`e666c4b60`), piece 2 (`dc12ca51b`) and the LIN-4463 `llms.txt` Waiting settle (`f384430ec`) are intact. The blind-read AST scan passes with the record keyed `[BLIND_READ_KIND]`, and `KEYED_TABLES` now allows `GENERATE`. Nothing is reverted or re-applied.
- Class: hand-typed lists of every stage kind outside the record. A search for kind literals in `lib/`, `routes/`, `public/js` and `server.js` finds only the staying tables, `JOBS` (`lib/llm-jobs.js`) and `BUCKET_OF_KIND` (`lib/wall-clock-summary.js`), plus the `GENERATE` keys. **No unhandled sibling.**

### Tests and mutations
- Re-run on head: the record, witness, tables, traits, budget, prompt-templates, completion-signals and stage-intent-cut tests. 631 of 631 pass.
- Mutations, each reverted after:
  - M1 drop `plan.catalogue`: record field test red.
  - M2 hand-edit an `llms.txt` bullet: catalogue test red.
  - M3 change a signal: witness `COMPLETION_SIGNALS` red.
  - M4a import `run-view.js` into the record: all three files red.
  - M4b import the non-listed leaf `leftover-words.js`: transitive-leaf test red.
  - M5 change a lead: witness renders red.
  - M6 change a label: `STAGE_LABELS` red.
  - M7 give look-into `DECIDE`: reading-pass relation red.
  - M8 triage `writes: WORK`: `PINNED` red.
- Every load-bearing test bites. The test level fits: a pure data refactor witnessed by rendered output, plus goldens and E2E in CI.

### What CI Did Not Prove
1. **LIN-4447 has not been told that `COMPLETION_SIGNALS` became a view.** *Inside*: the ask's Collisions sentence. **Before the merge**, close-out posts on LIN-4447 that `lib/completion-signals.js` is now a view of `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`. The signal text moved there and the values are byte-identical (witness `tables.COMPLETION_SIGNALS`), so LIN-4462's after-read reads a different file shape than the before-read. Settled when that comment exists on LIN-4447.
2. **The budget raise is re-accounting only on the condition that LIN-4469 lowers the total.** *Inside*: this ticket's acceptance of +17660 depends on it. **Before the merge**, close-out comments on LIN-4469: piece 5 must show a net rendered-byte reduction and lower `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` below 396575, and the raise from LIN-4467 is conditional on that. **A named monitor**: `tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js` fails on any growth past 396575. Only LIN-4469's own landing can show the reduction.
3. **`STAGE_INTENT`'s reading-pass lines do not yet follow from `writes`.** *Inside*: an As-asked bullet. **Before the merge**, close-out makes fix 1 and confirms `tests/unit/lin-4467-stage-kind-witness.test.js` stays green: renders and `STAGE_INTENT` unchanged.
4. **`lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` has not shrunk to the tables that stay.** *Inside*: witness (ii). **Before the merge**, close-out makes fix 2. Settled when a copy of M8 (triage `writes: WORK`) still turns the `PINNED` test red after the deletion.

### Fixes for close-out
1. `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`: derive the reading-pass line from `writes`. Add a map `READING_PASS = { [WRITES.NONE]: READING, [WRITES.ONE_COMMENT]: READING, [WRITES.BLIND_COMMENT]: BLIND }`. Set `intent: null` on the six records whose intent is only that line (look-into, context, retro, survey-task, survey-place, blind-read; check that each has `writes` in the map). After the literal, add a pass that sets `record.intent = [READING_PASS[record.writes]]` wherever `READING_PASS[record.writes]` exists. Update the comments to match: the `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` describe title "related, not folded" and the relation paragraph in `lib/stage-writes.js:24–26` should say the line is derived and the test is its witness. The witness must stay green.
2. `tests/unit/lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js`: delete the `describe('LIN-4253 — every template declares both traits …')` block (lines 95–112). `recordProblems` in `lin-4467-stage-kind-record.test.js` and its view test (`template.route` and `template.writes` equal the record's) now cover it. Keep `PINNED`, the derived sets, the reading-pass relation, the router refusal and the readers' no-list blocks.
3. `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md`, the LIN-4467 row (last line): after the verb-override clause, add "; the public catalogue in `public/llms.txt` follows registry order (`plan`, and the `retro`/`retrospective-audit` pair, move; no bullet's text changes)".
4. If fix 1 changes `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js` bytes past 43001, raise that ceiling and `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` by the same delta, with a reason, or net it to zero. A removal is more likely.
5. Comment on LIN-4448: piece 3's BLOCKED (21:23Z) is cleared by the settlement on LIN-4467 and by this review's reading. Neither departure is a cut of the block: it imports `blind-read-words.js` itself, and witness (ii) keeps `lin-4253`'s pin table.

Outside finds: none.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

### Leftovers

- tidied: `lib/completion-signals.js` header said it "defines" the signals; it now reads them from the records.
- tidied: the `tests/unit/lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` and `tests/unit/stage-intent-cut.test.js` headers named the template and `stage-intent.js` as the homes; they now name `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`.
- tidied: `tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js`'s surface list omitted the records from templates source and described `stage-intent.js` as holding the lines.
- tidied: `docs/areas/README.md` pointed prompt text at `lib/prompts/stage-intent.js`; it now points at `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`.
- tidied (settled by the change): removed the platform Waiting entry on `lib/workflow-config.js` importing `BLIND_READ_KIND` for `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS`. Both are gone; the file imports nothing again.
- tidied: the LLM Waiting entry on `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js` said LIN-4467 was the natural home for a per-kind constant. The record is keyed by literals, so the question stands; the entry now says so.
- noted, other-features: `lib/stage-writes.js`'s header still names `stage-intent.js` and the template as the homes of the reading-pass text and `writes` (outside the area).
- noted, LLM Lessons: the blind-read scan reads `git ls-files`, so a new file is not scanned until committed.

Retires: `lib/code-routes.js`: the review loop bound's step lives in its `CODE_ROUTES` entry

`reviewLoopStep` now sits beside `reviewLoopStop` in `lib/recommendation-facts.js` and holds the bound's two reasons, byte for byte (pinned by lin-4465). The entry delegates like the other three, and a new test fails on the old entry.

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2444, head `22817a88b3e4d995da983825e89f5b12c206132e`. CI green on that head (run 43511543482: unit, unit proxy, secret scan, four E2E shards, CI success).

## Blind read
Verdict: better. It made things better by putting each stage kind in one record (`lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`), so COMPLETION_SIGNALS, STAGE_INTENT, the contract lines, STAGE_LEADS, STAGE_LABELS, GROUNDING_BY_KIND, the verb-override list and the llms.txt catalogue are now derived from it instead of kept by hand, and it deleted `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` from `lib/workflow-config.js`. It made things worse only in small ways: a stale architecture doc, a third copy of the category values, a dead import, and a hash-pinned witness test that every later prompt edit will have to regenerate.

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2444 at `22817a88b` against `b8e2a0aad`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md` (llm-and-prompts): the close-out paragraph still says a kind registers through "`PROMPT_TEMPLATES` entry …, `COMPLETION_SIGNALS['close-out']`, and `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.CLOSE_OUT`". `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` no longer exists, and a kind now registers as a `STAGE_KINDS` record plus a `GENERATE` entry. Fix: rewrite that clause to name the record and the `GENERATE` map.
- `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js` (llm-and-prompts): `STANDING_POLICY_LINE` is imported from `../size-of-move.js` and never used. Fix: drop it from the import.
- `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js` (llm-and-prompts): `category` is now a string literal ('universal', 'work-issue', 'ready'), while `PROMPT_CATEGORIES` in `lib/prompt-formatters.js` still owns those values for `CATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES`, and `tests/unit/lin-4467-stage-kind-record.test.js` types them a third time in `CATEGORIES`. Fix: make the test check against `Object.values(PROMPT_CATEGORIES)`, so a renamed category fails there.
- `lib/prompts/stage-intent.js` (llm-and-prompts): it re-exports `CUT` and `DECIDE` from `stage-kinds.js`, and only tests import them from here (`stage-intent-cut.test.js`, `lin-4369-scoping-size-record.test.js`), even though the first of those now says the rule's home is `stage-kinds.js`. Fix: point those two imports at `stage-kinds.js` and drop the re-export.
- `lib/completion-signals.js` (runs-and-dispatch): every record must now carry `signals`, so the `!== null` filter in `getDefinedSignalTypes` and the `CompletionSignal|null` type are dead, and the function lost its JSDoc in the move. Fix: remove the filter (or the function, if it has no readers) and fix the type.
- `tests/unit/prompt-templates.test.js` (llm-and-prompts): the "llms.txt prompt catalog stays in sync" block (count header plus one bullet per kind) is now a weaker copy of the byte-for-byte generated-section check in `lin-4467-stage-kind-record.test.js`. Fix: delete the count and bullet tests and keep only the "All N templates above" cross-reference test, which checks text outside the generated section.

### Inside the area, larger
- `tests/fixtures/lin-4467-witness.js` (llm-and-prompts): a witness for a one-off refactor ("captured at HEAD before the one-record refactor") is left in as a permanent test. It pins a sha256 for all 40 renders and for each table, so any later wording change in any stage has to regenerate this fixture, on top of the byte ceilings and the change log. Its "fix round" mode also differs from "fresh" for `implementation` only, so for the other 19 kinds it witnesses nothing extra. Whether to retire it, fold it into the size budget, or keep it as a ratchet is a decision about the test suite, not a fix.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4467

**Merged:** [PR #2444](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2444), squash commit `8fea3869f019530c0e3ec7847e138d3b25718d98`, pinned with `--match-head-commit` to `a9b216d88`, the commit CI passed on. Deployed: harbour.cat's footer shows `8fea386`, and the live `llms.txt` is identical to the merged `public/llms.txt`.

**How it meets what was asked:** review's account stands (requirements sentence by sentence, 80 of 80 renders byte-identical, mutations M1–M8). The only moves in output are the three declared ones: triage's description names `state, project` for `assignee`, the verb-override list names all 20 kinds (was 16), and the `llms.txt` catalogue follows registry order (no bullet's text changes).

**CI:** all green on the exact merged head `a9b216d88` (Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). I also ran the full unit suite locally before pushing: 25807 of 25807 pass. CI on `main` after the merge: success.

### Changes I made after the approval (nobody re-reads these)

description:
## As asked

Piece 3 of LIN-4448's plan (behaviour **C**). **One record per stage kind**, with today's parallel tables becoming derived views that are deleted in the same piece.

**Approach**

* An import-free leaf holds one record per kind: route, writes, label, grounding, signals, and template/trait metadata. It takes the blind read's kind and heading from `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js` (piece 2).
* Don't add a `STAGE_KINDS` beside the tables. Each superseded table goes in this piece.
* Views of the record: `PROMPT_TEMPLATES`, `STAGE_LEADS`'s traits, `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`, `STAGE_LABELS` (only the literal in `lib/run-view.js`), and the `route`/`writes` pins.
* **Enumerate the tables from** `stage-kind-tables.test.js`**, not from the plan's list** (review note 8). That includes `STAGE_INTENT` (`lib/prompts/stage-intent.js`; its reading-pass lines follow from `writes`), `JOBS` (`lib/llm-jobs.js`), `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` (`lib/workflow-config.js`, platform), the prompt contract, and the proxy-instructions override list. Each one either becomes a view or is named in the rewritten Waiting entry as staying, with its owner and reason.
* **These stay with Runs (A13):** `SPINE`, `BUCKET_OF_KIND`, `FIRST_PASS_KINDS`, `OFF_SPINE_KINDS`, with their tests. Byte ceilings stay in the budget test, not the record.
* **Assignee (settled at breakdown, as an engineering call):** follow `lib/stage-writes.js`, which leaves assignee out of `ticket-fields`. Correct the triage template's description ("labels, priority, assignee") in this piece. Reason: piece 4 enforces `stage-writes.js`, a stamp may only narrow a token, and nothing asks to widen triage's writes.
* Generate the prompt catalogue in `public/llms.txt` from the records. Its test then checks content, not just that each bullet exists.

**Testing (witnesses)**

* (i) Render every kind, fresh and fix round, with **real context** at HEAD and on the branch. They are byte-identical except where this PR says otherwise. The context-free budget fixture is not enough (LIN-4393).
* (ii) `stage-kind-tables.test.js` and `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` shrink to the tables that stay. A test checks the required fields: a kind added to the record without a field fails.
* (iii) Existing traits hold, and the run-page labels and goldens are unchanged.

**Collisions:** `COMPLETION_SIGNALS` is Runs-registered. Making it a view changes the read sample for LIN-4447's after-read (LIN-4462), so say so on LIN-4447. `lib/run-view.js` is shared with LIN-4447's pieces and PR #2427. `docs/architecture/source-map.md` is shared with piece 1. `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` and the budget test are shared with piece 5, which lands after this one.

**Retires:** those tables; the "\~fourteen parallel tables" Waiting entry, rewritten to name every table that stays and why (more than four); and the hand-copied catalogue bullets in `llms.txt`.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4448 (LLM & prompts, left simpler). The full approved plan is the parent's description, section `## Implementation Plan`, and its amendments are in the parent's comment `### Plan Review Verdict` (72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09). The parent's `## As asked` block sets the scope.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4448's approving plan-review (comment 72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09, rev 1)

**Grounding commits:** the plan was written at `JKershaw/LinearViewer` main `2bf788b6d` (surveys at `4b5001ddf`) and reviewed at `c205190fd`. The breakdown re-checked at `5dcf5bcda`. The only change since is LIN-4457 (#2424), and the one plan file it touches is the cost-read entry in `docs/architecture/source-map.md`.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course, and say so in a comment on LIN-4448.

**Every PR names what it retires** (the LIN-4414 rule). It edits the Waiting entries in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` that it settles. It respects that note's Lessons and leaves `docs/reviews/` reports unchanged.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Delivers the piece as asked, one definition per stage kind from which prompts, signals, grounding, labels, write limits and the public catalogue derive; no survey finding binds beyond it, and the parent's ruled rebuild already sizes it.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented (stub; the surveys and the working notes are pruned)

Merged as [PR #2444](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2444>), commit `8fea3869f`, deployed. One record per stage kind in `lib/prompts/stage-kinds.js`; the per-kind tables are views of it, `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` is deleted, and the `public/llms.txt` catalogue is generated from the records. The parent's approved plan was implemented as approved, with the departures settled on LIN-4467 and LIN-4448 ("imports leaves only"; the route/writes pins stay hand-typed; the byte total re-accounted). Full history: the task snapshots and the comment trail (review, blind read, close-out).
